01-04.t: 喬治·哈里森（George Harrison）與保羅·麥卡尼（Paul McCartney）及林哥·史達（Ringo Starr）一同為同名原聲帶專輯中的歌曲〈Let It Be〉錄製疊錄音軌，這也是他最後一次參與披頭四（The Beatles）的錄音行程。
01-04.en: Harrison's last recording session with the Beatles was on 4 January 1970, when he, McCartney and Starr recorded overdubs to the song "Let It Be" for the soundtrack album of the same name.

01-22.t: 佳士得（Christie's）在倫敦拍賣了傑夫·貝克（Jeff Beck）的九十把吉他，同時拍賣的還有超過四十件他個人收藏的其他物品。
01-22.en: Ninety of Beck's guitars were auctioned by Christie's on London on 22 January 2025, along with over 40 other items from his personal collection.

02-15.t: 尼爾·楊（Neil Young）發行了第四張專輯《Harvest》，這張專輯也是美國當年銷量最好的專輯。
02-15.en: The result was Young's fourth album, Harvest (February 15, 1972), which was also the best selling album of 1972 in the US.

02-17.t: 澳洲搖滾樂團 AC/DC 在當地發行了他們的首張專輯《High Voltage》，並同步推出單曲〈Baby, Please Don't Go〉與〈Love Song〉。
02-17.en: AC/DC released their debut album, High Voltage, exclusively in Australia on 17 February 1975, along with a single "Baby, Please Don't Go" / "Love Song".

02-18.t: 德·盧西亞（de Lucía）成為首位在馬德里皇家劇院（Teatro Real of Madrid）登台演出的佛朗明哥（flamenco）表演者。
02-18.en: On 18 February 1975, de Lucía became the first-ever flamenco performer to perform at the Teatro Real of Madrid.

03-18.t: 吉他手蘭迪·羅德斯（Randy Rhoads）在諾克斯維爾市政體育館（Knoxville Civic Coliseum）完成了他的最後一場演出。
03-18.en: Rhoads played his last show on Thursday, March 18, 1982, at the Knoxville Civic Coliseum.

03-25.t: 約翰·麥克勞夫林（John McLaughlin）與吉米·罕醉克斯（Jimi Hendrix）在紐約（New York）的唱片工廠錄音室（Record Plant）進行即興合奏，並留下了錄音紀錄。
03-25.en: A recording from the Record Plant, NYC, dated 25 March 1969, exists of McLaughlin jamming with Jimi Hendrix.

04-01.t: 史萊許（Slash）在洛杉磯（Los Angeles）的吟遊詩人（Troubadour）參與槍與玫瑰（Guns N' Roses）的祕密暖身演出，這是他相隔二十三年後首次與該樂團同台表演。
04-01.en: Slash performed with Guns N' Roses for the first time in 23 years during the band's secret warmup gig at the Troubadour in Los Angeles on 1 April 2016.

04-28.t: 艾達·普雷斯蒂（Ida Presti）在十歲時，於巴黎（Paris）普萊耶音樂廳（Salle Pleyel）舉辦了她的首場完整音樂會。
04-28.en: Presti played in public for the first time when she was eight, and gave her first full-length concert at the age of ten, on 28 April 1935 at the Salle Pleyel in Paris.

04-29.t: 樂團討伐體制（Rage Against the Machine）在科切拉音樂節（Coachella Music Festival）上重新聚首登台演出。這場表演最初被認為是單次演出，但樂團隨後又進行了更多場演出。
04-29.en: On April 29, 2007, Rage Against the Machine reunited at the Coachella Music Festival.

05-12.t: 吉米·罕醉克斯（Jimi Hendrix）的首張專輯《Are You Experienced》在英國發行後，在排行榜上停留了三十三週，最高名次達到第二名。
05-12.en: Released in the UK on May 12, 1967, Are You Experienced spent 33 weeks on the charts, peaking at number two.

06-03.t: 布萊恩·梅（Brian May）在伊莉莎白二世（Elizabeth II）金禧慶典上，登上白金漢宮（Buckingham Palace）屋頂吉他獨奏〈God Save the Queen〉。
06-03.en: As part of the Golden Jubilee of Elizabeth II celebrations on 3 June 2002, May performed a guitar solo of "God Save the Queen" from the roof of Buckingham Palace, with the performance appearing on the 30th Anniversary DVD edition of A Night at the Opera.

06-13.t: 史提夫·雷·沃恩（Stevie Ray Vaughan）發行了專輯《Texas Flood》。該專輯最高登上排行榜第38名，最終售出50萬張。
06-13.en: Released on June 13, 1983, Texas Flood peaked at number 38 and ultimately sold half a million copies.

07-01.t: 吉他手喬·帕斯（Joe Pass）發行了他的首張錄音室專輯《Sounds of Synanon》。
07-01.en: Pass released his studio debut Sounds of Synanon on July 1, 1962.

07-02.t: 平克·佛洛伊德（Pink Floyd）與羅傑·華特斯（Roger Waters）重新聚首，在 Live 8 登台演出。這場演出帶動了精選專輯《Echoes: The Best of Pink Floyd》銷量的增加。
07-02.en: On 2 July 2005, Pink Floyd reunited with Waters to perform at Live 8.

07-13.t: 亞伯特·柯林斯（Albert Collins）在費城（Philadelphia）Live Aid 慈善音樂會，與喬治·梭羅古德（George Thorogood）同台，在〈Madison Blues〉中擔任客座獨奏。
07-13.en: On July 13, 1985, Collins performed with George Thorogood and the Destroyers at Live Aid, appearing as guest soloist on "Madison Blues"; the US part of the charity concert was held at JFK Stadium in Philadelphia and, with simultaneous broadcasts in other countries, was viewed by over 1.5 billion people.

07-31.t: 艾瑞克·強森（Eric Johnson）在電視節目《奧斯汀城市極限》（Austin City Limits）帶來突破性的登台演出。這場表演被錄製了下來，日後發行成 CD 與 DVD。
07-31.en: His breakthrough appearance at Austin City Limits on July 31, 1984, was recorded and later released on CD/DVD in 2010.

08-01.t: 喬治·哈里森（George Harrison）應拉維·香卡（Ravi Shankar）的要求，組織了一場名為《Concert for Bangladesh》的慈善活動。
08-01.en: Harrison responded to a request from Ravi Shankar by organising a charity event, the Concert for Bangladesh, which took place on 1 August 1971.

08-16.t: 尼爾·楊（Neil Young）與史蒂芬·史提爾斯（Stephen Stills）等人組成的四人樂團在芝加哥首次登台，隨後在伍德斯托克音樂節演出，期間尼爾·楊（Neil Young）跳過大部分的木吉他表演，並拒絕在電吉他表演時被拍攝。
08-16.en: The quartet debuted in Chicago on August 16, 1969, and later performed at the famous Woodstock Festival, during which Young skipped the majority of the acoustic set and refused to be filmed during the electric set, even telling the cameramen: "One of you fuckin' guys comes near me and I'm gonna fuckin' hit you with my guitar".

08-16.t: 搖滾樂推廣人比爾·葛拉罕（Bill Graham）在山塔那（Santana）樂團首張專輯尚未發行前，安排樂團登上胡士托音樂與藝術節（Woodstock Music and Art Festival）演出。
08-16.en: Major rock music promoter Bill Graham, a Latin music aficionado who had been a fan of Santana from its inception, arranged for the band to appear on August 16, 1969 at the Woodstock Music and Art Festival before its debut album was even released.

08-26.t: 佛萊迪·金（Freddie King）為該唱片廠牌錄製了個人首張單曲，收錄〈Have You Ever Loved a Woman〉與〈You've Got to Love Her with a Feeling〉兩首歌曲。
08-26.en: King recorded his debut single for the label on August 26, 1960: "Have You Ever Loved a Woman" backed with "You've Got to Love Her with a Feeling" (again credited as Freddy King).

09-13.t: 討伐體制樂團（Rage Against the Machine）在洛杉磯（Los Angeles）的大奧林匹克體育館（Grand Olympic Auditorium）舉行了他們最後的演唱會。
09-13.en: On September 13, 2000, Rage Against the Machine performed their last concert, at the Grand Olympic Auditorium in Los Angeles.

09-16.t: 艾達·普雷斯蒂（Ida Presti）在法國首演了羅德里哥的《Concierto de Aranjuez》，這場演出透過巴黎的廣播電台播送，並在其他多個歐洲大陸的電台播出。
09-16.en: On 16 September 1948, Presti gave the French premiere of Rodrigo's Concierto de Aranjuez, which was broadcast on radio from Paris and also carried on several other continental stations.

11-02.t: 姜戈·萊恩哈特（Django Reinhardt）在一九二八年十一月二日的夜晚，準備回到他和妻子在馬車營地共用的馬車上就寢。
11-02.en: On the night of 2 November 1928, Reinhardt was going to bed in the wagon that he and his wife shared in the caravan.

11-06.t: 約翰·威廉斯（John Williams）在倫敦（London）威格摩爾音樂廳（Wigmore Hall）舉辦了首次專業演出。此後他在世界各地演出，並定期在廣播與電視上亮相。
11-06.en: Since his first professional performance at the Wigmore Hall in London on 6 November 1958, Williams has performed throughout the world and has made regular appearances on radio and TV.

11-07.t: 大衛·吉爾摩（David Gilmour）與尼克·梅森（Nick Mason）重新審視了先前與理查·萊特（Richard Wright）在《The Division Bell》錄音期間製作的錄音，藉此創作了全新的平克·佛洛伊德（Pink Floyd）專輯《The Endless River》。
11-07.en: Gilmour and Mason revisited recordings made with Wright during the Division Bell sessions to create a new Pink Floyd album, The Endless River, released on 7 November 2014.

11-10.t: 黑色安息日（Black Sabbath）在倫敦聖安妮法院的三叉戟錄音室（Trident Studios）錄製了歌曲〈Evil Woman〉與其 B 面曲〈Wicked World〉。
11-10.en: The band recorded the song "Evil Woman" and its B-side '"Wicked World" on 10 November 1969 at Trident Studios on St.
